correctness.rationale: At each boundary zero, local holomorphic factorization gives f=psi^ell. The weighted level and area elements cancel the conformal Jacobian exactly, reducing the problem to the angular measure of the analytic image boundary. Its signed-curvature expansion is pi-kappa*rho+O(rho^2); direct integration yields the claimed coefficients. The curvature transformation is reconstructed explicitly and the identity model f(z)=z-1 verifies the sign.

value.rationale: The lead theorem's boundary coefficient is universal and depends only on multiplicity. The accepted refinement identifies the first nonuniversal coefficient and shows that it is a canonical signed curvature of the normalized boundary germ. It separates functions with identical zero multiplicities and leading asymptotics, gives a quantitative finite-epsilon correction, and has an especially transparent simple-zero formula.
